## Progress

- [PR #666](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/666): sign-up and the six-step wizard (/signup, /onboarding): sign-up creates the account only through the provider's MFA sign-in; the draft (identity.OnboardingDrafts) autosaves, resumes at the same step after signing in again, and a step is checked by the server (country rule classes: India council list + registration number, UAE DoH/DHA/MOHAP licence, GSTIN optional format, TRN 15 digits) with errors under the field and announced; an owner who is not a doctor skips the licence step
- Finishing creates tenant (bound to the country), facility, owner membership, practice profile with hours and fee defaults (integer minor units) and the doctor's licence in one transaction under row-level security, writes the audit event in the new tenant, then sends step-6 invitations through the P0 invitation flow; a deployment serving one country refuses the other (Onboarding:DeploymentCountry)
- Recording and signing capabilities (clinical notes, prescriptions, recording, AI drafts, result review) are None in IStaffAccess while the licence is unverified, so every capability policy refuses them; booking and registering stay; the shell shows the designed notice (gate mutation-checked)
- Browser (mocked API, English and Arabic RTL, 768 px, keyboard, axe clean) and Testcontainers SQL Server tests; J1 step 1 implemented
- Left: store the certificate file in Blob (only its name is kept; needs the Blob upload path, MDV-P0-006); back-office licence verification that sets VerifiedAt (MDV-P1-007); mobile/SMS invitations in step 6 (MDV-P1-033); claim the draft in the same transaction as the tenant so a double submit cannot create two practices (when drafts and tenants share a store); the live country's sign-up address (PublicSite:Deployments:SignUpUrls, MDV-P0-003); several doctors and locations (MDV-P1-005, MDV-P1-007)

## Description

Steps: 1 Your profile · 2 Licence (council/authority, number, certificate upload; "Verification pending" notice) · 3 Clinic (name, address, CE reg./facility licence, GSTIN/TRN) · 4 Hours & fees · 5 Note templates (multi-select, used from P2/P3) · 6 Invite your team (optional). Progress autosaves; the user can leave and resume; "Finish · go to Today". Clinic mode supports several doctors and locations (owner who is not a doctor skips step 2).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each step validates per country (India council list/registration number; UAE DoH/DHA/MOHAP licence; GSTIN optional format check; TRN 15 digits) with errors shown under the field and announced via aria-live.
- [ ] **AC2.** Leaving mid-wizard and signing in again resumes at the same step with saved values.
- [ ] **AC3.** Until licence verification, the doctor can book and register patients; recording/signing capabilities are disabled with the designed notice (feature-level check, not just UI).
- [ ] **AC4.** Step 6 sends invitations through the P0 invitation flow (MDV-P0-013).
- [ ] **AC5.** Finishing lands on the role's home (Today for doctors, Front desk for owners/reception) and creates tenant, facility, membership, practice profile, hours and fee defaults.
- [ ] **AC6.** The whole wizard works at 768 px (tablet) and is keyboard-completable.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
